note: From-scratch 14-day seasonal PvP economy. Replaces packages/rules/src/constants.ts. Every number here is derived; see docs/balance.md for the formula behind each one.

formulas.production: rate(L) = base * L * growth^L   per hour
formulas.upgradeCost: cost(L->L+1) = { alloy: costBase * costMult^L, crystal: crystalCostBase * crystalCostMult^L }
formulas.crystalCostMult: DERIVED = costMult * (crystalMult / alloyMult) — holds the crystal cost share at 0.79 of the crystal income share at every level
formulas.storage: storageCap = capHours * rate ; worksCap = worksHours * rate
formulas.vault: protects(L) = vaultFlat + vaultCoef * L * vaultMult^L  (alloy); crystal = alloy * crystalBase/alloyBase
formulas.buildTime: minutes = min(cap, costTotal / throughput) — buildings: 200*(1+0.12*core); ships: 260*(1+0.35*yard); ground: 1000*(1+0.35*yard); research: x4
formulas.sunset: building is rational while paybackHours < hoursRemaining * 0.4
formulas.loot: raidable = max(0, storage - vaultFloor) + works * lootBufferShare ; loot = min(raidable * gradeShare, surviving cargo)
formulas.debris: field = share * resourceValue of every destroyed NON-GROUND hull on both sides

parameters.practicalCeiling: A 14-day season tops out near Refinery 16-18; 20 is headroom, not a target.

queues.note: Two independent queues. Cancelling refunds cancelRefund of what was committed, which is what prices "dump resources into a queue to dodge a raid".

200.unchanged: every production, cost, hull, loot, combat and build-time number

300.unchanged: every production, cost, hull, loot, combat and build-time number

400.unchanged: every production, cost, hull, loot, combat and build-time number

500.unchanged: every production, cost, hull, loot, combat and build-time number

invariants: vaultMult (1.08) < alloyMult (1.10) — else the vault eventually protects 100% of storage and PvP dies silently
crystalCostMult is DERIVED from costMult * (crystalMult/alloyMult) — two hand-picked multipliers drift and invert which resource is scarce
START is arithmetic: exactly Core+Refinery+Extractor 1->2 plus two Wasps
worksHours (12) >= the 2-logins-per-day gap — this single number decides whether a casual player is excluded
buildTime is priced in RESOURCES, so it moves automatically when any price moves
one Thorn must build faster than a Radar L3 warning at median distance, or the radar stops selling the window to arm
no building may exceed the Command Core
ground hulls leave no debris — they already have 60% salvage
debris is strictly downstream of combat; if raiding stops, debris stops
